verdict.rationale: Netlify is a deployment and hosting platform with preview environments, so isolating non-production from production services is a fair question. The evidence never documents network isolation or per-environment controls that stop previews from reaching production services. The closest items are adjacent: team-scoped secrets and env vars, deploy previews, and generic security or password protection, none of which is environment isolation.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
